79914407.title: Papal inauguration of Pope Leo XIV
79914407.extract:
On 18 May 2025, Pope Leo XIV celebrated the inauguration Mass of his pontificate, formally known as the "Mass for the Beginning of the Petrine Ministry of the Bishop of Rome". The event was attended by some 200,000 people, including dozens of world leaders and 150 formal delegations. While Leo became the Roman pontiff at the moment of his acceptance in the Sistine Chapel upon being elected in the 2025 papal conclave, the inauguration celebration marked the formal beginning of his ministry as the bishop of Rome. The Mass included the bestowal of the pallium and Ring of the Fisherman, and was followed by meetings with various delegations and world leaders.


== Ceremony ==

Prior to the ceremony, Leo toured St. Peter's Square in the popemobile for the first time, where attendees shouted Viva il Papa! (Long live the Pope), and "USA, USA!" with at least one person chanting "White Sox!", referencing his country of birth and favorite baseball team. Others waved Peruvian or American flags for the countries that claim him as a citizen. 
The liturgy formally began at 10 a.m. at Saint Peter's tomb underneath the baldachin of the high altar of St. Peter's Basilica. Surrounded by the patriarchs of the Eastern Catholic Churches, Leo incensed the tomb while the choir sang Tu es Petrus, a motet by Giovanni Pierluigi da Palestrina. Ascending from the grottoes, Leo was joined in procession to the square by two deacons holding the Ring of the Fisherman and the papal pallium, as well as cardinals and bishops. The traditional Laudes Regiae chant was sung during the procession. Leo then conducted the asperges rite, typical on Sundays of Eastertide.

The first reading, from Acts 4:8-12, was proclaimed in Spanish, referencing Leo's work in the Diocese of Chiclayo. Psalm 118 was sung in Italian, for his new diocese; the second reading, from 1 Peter 5:1-5, 10-11, was proclaimed in English by a faculty member from the Pontifical North American College, referencing Leo's native tongue. The Gospel, John 21:15-19, was chanted in Latin by a deacon from the Diocese of Fort Wayne–South Bend, Indiana, then subsequently chanted in Greek.
Representing the cardinal deacons, Mario Zenari imposed the pallium on Leo's shoulders. Then, representing the cardinal priests, Fridolin Ambongo Besungu conferred a prayer of blessing on the pope. Finally, Luis Antonio Tagle, for cardinal bishops, bestowed the Ring of the Fisherman upon the pontiff; Leo appeared visibly moved by the moment. Following the investment of the insignia, twelve delegates representing the Catholic Church from around the world, including clerics, vowed religious, a married couple, and young adults, were received by Leo. The homily delivered by Leo followed, where he spoke in Italian.
The prayers of the faithful were delivered in Arabic, Chinese, French, Polish, and Portuguese. Tu es pastor ovium was chanted during the offertory. Leo prayed the Roman Canon.
Before the conclusion of Mass, Leo offered some brief remarks, especially offering prayers for the conflicts in Gaza, Myanmar, and Ukraine. The Regina cæli was sung, followed by the final blessing.
Some 30 heads of state, 200 cardinals, and 750 bishops and priests were present. Throughout the ceremony, Leo used the papal ferula commonly used by Pope John Paul II.


=== Formalities ===
Princess Charlene of Monaco, Queen Letizia of Spain, Queen Mathilde of Belgium, and Grand Duchess Maria Teresa of Luxembourg exercised the privilège du blanc extended to Catholic royalty by wearing white to the ceremony.


== Homily ==
Leo began his sermon by thanking those who were present and remembering the emotions of the previous weeks following the death of Pope Francis and subsequent conclave. Recalling the two-fold aspects of ministry entrusted to Saint Peter, love and unity, Leo said he would approach the Church as a brother and servant and with "fear and trembling". Leo expressed a desire for unity and communion in the Church and in the world. He condemned exploitation of Earth's resources and marginalization of the poor. He referenced his papal motto, "in the one Christ, we are one", and exclaimed "Look to Christ! Come closer to him!"


== Subsequent activities ==
After the ceremony, Leo entered St. Peter's basilica and met with 150 delegations in front of the St. Peter's baldachin. Among the delegations was his brother Louis, whom he embraced. After the inauguration, Leo met with Peruvian president Dina Boluarte and Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
On Monday, 19 May, Leo met with US Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio. Vance appeared to give Leo a Chicago Bears jersey with the name "Pope Leo" and number "XIV". Leo also met with Gustavo Petro, president of Colombia; Bartholomew, the ecumenical patriarch of Constantinople; Gerardo Werthein, Minister of Foreign Affairs and Worship of Argentina; and representatives of other churches, ecclesiastical communities, and religions.
In the days following the inauguration, Leo took possession of the other major basilicas, with ceremonies held at the Basilica of Saint Paul Outside the Walls on 20 May, and at the Archbasilica of Saint John Lateran and the Basilica of Santa Maria Maggiore on 25 May, formally installing him as the Bishop of Rome.

==== Other religions ====
Jewish, Muslim, Hindu, Buddhist, Sikh, Zoroastrian and Jainist leaders were present.

On 18 May 2025, [[Pope Leo XIV]] celebrated the [[papal inauguration|inauguration]] Mass of his pontificate, formally known as the "Mass for the Beginning of the Petrine Ministry of the Bishop of Rome".<ref name="Pillar">{{cite news |last1=Coppen |first1=Luke |last2=Flynn |first2=JD |date=18 May 2025 |title=Leo XIV at inauguration Mass: 'Look to Christ!' |url=https://www.pillarcatholic.com/p/leo-xiv-at-inauguration-mass-look |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250518103256/https://www.pillarcatholic.com/p/leo-xiv-at-inauguration-mass-look |archive-date=18 May 2025 |access-date=19 May 2025 |work=The Pillar |language=en }}</ref> The event was attended by some 200,000 people, including dozens of world leaders and 150 formal delegations.<ref name="Bigg">{{cite news |last1=Bigg |first1=Matthew Mpoke |last2=Povoledo |first2=Elisabetta |date=18 May 2025 |title=Pope Leo XIV's Inaugural Mass Draws World Leaders and Catholic Faithful |url=https://www.nytimes.com/live/2025/05/18/world/pope-leo-xiv-mass |access-date=19 May 2025 |work=The New York Times }}</ref> While Leo became the Roman pontiff at the moment of his acceptance in the [[Sistine Chapel]] upon being elected in the [[2025 papal conclave]], the inauguration celebration marked the formal beginning of his ministry as the [[bishop of Rome]].<ref name="Pillar" /> The Mass included the bestowal of the [[pallium]] and [[Ring of the Fisherman]], and was followed by meetings with various delegations and world leaders.

==Ceremony==
[[File:Leone XIV - 18-05-2025.jpg|thumb|Leo blessing and greeting crowds in the [[popemobile]] prior to the ceremony]]
[[File:Coat of arms of Leone XIV.svg|right|thumb|200px|Pope Leo XIV's [[coat of arms]]]]
Prior to the ceremony, Leo toured [[St. Peter's Square]] in the [[popemobile]] for the first time, where attendees shouted ''{{Lang|it|Viva il Papa}}!'' (Long live the Pope),<ref name=Pillar/> and "[[U-S-A!|USA, USA!]]"<ref>{{cite news |last1=O'Connell |first1=Gerard |title=Pope Leo XIV at inaugural Mass: 'This is the hour for love' |url=https://www.americamagazine.org/faith/2025/05/18/pope-leo-installation-mass-250712 |access-date=19 May 2025 |work=America Magazine |date=18 May 2025 |language=en }}</ref> with at least one person chanting "[[White Sox]]!",<ref name=Anderson/> referencing his country of birth and favorite baseball team.<ref name=Pillar/> Others waved [[Flag of Peru|Peruvian]] or American flags for the countries that claim him as a citizen.<ref>{{Cite news |last1=McElwee |first1=Joshua |last2=Balmer |first2=Crispian |last3=Pullella |first3=Philip |date=18 May 2025 |title=Pope Leo urges unity for divided Church, vows not to be 'autocrat' |url=https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/pope-leo-take-charge-catholic-church-grandiose-inaugural-mass-2025-05-18/ |access-date=1 July 2025 |work=Reuters |language=en }}</ref> 

The liturgy formally began at 10{{nbsp}}a.m. at [[Saint Peter's tomb]] underneath [[St. Peter's Baldachin|the baldachin]] of the high altar of [[St. Peter's Basilica]]. Surrounded by the [[patriarch]]s of the [[Eastern Catholic Churches]], Leo incensed the tomb while the choir sang ''{{Lang|la|Tu es Petrus}}'', a [[motet]] by [[Giovanni Pierluigi da Palestrina]]. Ascending from the grottoes, Leo was joined in procession to the square by two deacons holding the [[Ring of the Fisherman]] and the papal [[pallium]], as well as cardinals and bishops. The traditional ''[[Laudes Regiae]]'' chant was sung during the procession. Leo then conducted the [[asperges]] rite, typical on Sundays of [[Eastertide]].<ref name=Pillar/>

[[File:Pope Leo XIV Inauguration.jpg|thumb|Leo in front of the altar]]
The first reading, from [[Acts 4|Acts 4:8-12]], was proclaimed in Spanish, referencing Leo's work in the [[Diocese of Chiclayo]]. [[Psalm 118]] was sung in Italian, for his new [[Diocese of Rome|diocese]]; the second reading, from [[1 Peter 5|1 Peter 5:1-5, 10-11]], was proclaimed in English by a faculty member from the [[Pontifical North American College]], referencing Leo's native tongue. The Gospel, [[Restoration of Peter|John 21:15-19]], was chanted in Latin by a deacon from the [[Roman Catholic Diocese of Fort Wayne–South Bend|Diocese of Fort Wayne–South Bend]], Indiana, then subsequently chanted in Greek.<ref name=Pillar/><ref name="Vatican News 2025">{{cite news |last1=Campisi |first1=Tiziana |title=The rite for the Inauguration of the Petrine Ministry of Leo XIV |url=https://www.vaticannews.va/en/pope/news/2025-05/rite-inauguration-petrine-ministry-leo-xiv-symbolism-rites.html |access-date=21 May 2025 |work=Vatican News |publisher=Holy See |date=16 May 2025 |ref=Vatican News 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250517215345/https://www.vaticannews.va/en/pope/news/2025-05/rite-inauguration-petrine-ministry-leo-xiv-symbolism-rites.html |archive-date=17 May 2025 }}</ref>

Representing the [[Cardinal (Catholic Church)#Cardinal deacons|cardinal deacons]], [[Mario Zenari]] imposed the [[pallium]] on Leo's shoulders. Then, representing the [[Cardinal (Catholic Church)#Cardinal priests|cardinal priests]], [[Fridolin Ambongo Besungu]] conferred a prayer of blessing on the pope. Finally, [[Luis Antonio Tagle]], for [[Cardinal (Catholic Church)#Cardinal bishops|cardinal bishops]], bestowed the [[Ring of the Fisherman]] upon the pontiff;<ref name=Pillar/> Leo appeared visibly moved by the moment.<ref name=Pillar/><ref name=Anderson/> Following the investment of the insignia, twelve delegates representing the Catholic Church from around the world, including clerics, vowed religious, a married couple, and young adults, were received by Leo. The homily delivered by Leo followed, where he spoke in Italian.<ref name=Pillar/>

The prayers of the faithful were delivered in Arabic, Chinese, French, Polish, and Portuguese. ''{{Lang|la|Tu es pastor ovium}}'' was chanted during the offertory. Leo prayed the [[Roman Canon]].<ref name=Pillar/>

Before the conclusion of Mass, Leo offered some brief remarks, especially offering prayers for the [[Gaza–Israel conflict|conflicts in Gaza]], [[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar]], and [[Russian invasion of Ukraine|Ukraine]]. The ''[[Regina Caeli|Regina cæli]]'' was sung, followed by the final blessing.<ref name=Pillar/>

Some 30 heads of state, 200 cardinals, and 750 bishops and priests were present.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Barone |first1=Camillo |last2=White |first2=Christopher |title=World leaders hear Pope Leo XIV condemn marginalization of the poor |url=https://www.ncronline.org/vatican/world-leaders-hear-pope-leo-xiv-condemn-marginalization-poor |access-date=19 May 2025 |work=National Catholic Reporter |date=18 May 2025 |language=en }}</ref> Throughout the ceremony, Leo used the [[papal ferula]] commonly used by [[Pope John Paul II]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Livingstone |first1=Tess |title=Pope Leo's nod to John Paul II |url=https://www.theaustralian.com.au/world/pope-leos-nod-to-john-paul-ii/news-story/c526db2f192e69cb35b608fd1a16ff57 |access-date=19 May 2025 |date=18 May 2025 }}</ref>

===Formalities===

Princess [[Charlene of Monaco]], Queen [[Letizia of Spain]], Queen [[Mathilde of Belgium]], and Grand Duchess [[Maria Teresa, Grand Duchess of Luxembourg|Maria Teresa of Luxembourg]] exercised the ''[[privilège du blanc]]'' extended to Catholic royalty by wearing white to the ceremony.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Henni |first1=Janine |title=Did Princess Charlene and Queen Letizia Break Style Protocol by Wearing White at Pope Leo's Inaugural Mass? |url=https://people.com/did-princess-charlene-queen-letizia-break-style-protocol-pope-inaugural-mass-11737368 |access-date=19 May 2025 |work=People.com |date=19 May 2025 |language=en }}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Gardiner |first1=Cerith |title=The queens who used the "privilege of white" at pope's Mass |url=https://aleteia.org/2025/05/19/the-queens-who-used-the-privilege-of-white-at-popes-mass |access-date=19 May 2025 |work=Aleteia |date=19 May 2025 |language=en }}</ref>

==Homily==

Leo began his sermon by thanking those who were present and remembering the emotions of the previous weeks following the [[death of Pope Francis]] and [[2025 papal conclave|subsequent conclave]]. Recalling the two-fold aspects of ministry entrusted to [[Saint Peter]], love and unity, Leo said he would approach the Church as a brother and servant and with "[[fear and trembling (biblical phrase)|fear and trembling]]".<ref name=VN>{{cite news |title=Pope Leo XIV at Inauguration Mass: 'Let us walk towards God and love one another' |url=https://www.vaticannews.va/en/pope/news/2025-05/pope-leo-xiv-let-us-walk-towards-god-and-love-one-another.html |access-date=19 May 2025 |work=Vatican News |date=18 May 2025 |language=en }}</ref> Leo expressed a desire for unity and communion in the Church and in the world.<ref name=Anderson/> He condemned exploitation of Earth's resources and marginalization of the poor.<ref name=VN/> He referenced his [[Coat of arms of Pope Leo XIV|papal motto]], "in the one Christ, we are one", and exclaimed "Look to Christ! Come closer to him!"<ref name=VN/><ref name=Pillar/>

==Subsequent activities==

After the ceremony, Leo entered St. Peter's basilica and met with 150 delegations in front of the St. Peter's baldachin.<ref name=Pillar/> Among the delegations was [[Family of Pope Leo XIV|his brother Louis]], whom he embraced.<ref name=Bigg/> After the inauguration, Leo met with Peruvian president [[Dina Boluarte]]<ref>{{cite news |last1=Catacora |first1=Por Mariana Quilca |title=¿Cuánto duró la reunión con el papa León XIV? Dina Boluarte y su canciller dan versiones distintas sobre el encuentro |url=https://www.infobae.com/peru/2025/05/20/reunion-entre-el-papa-leon-xiv-y-dina-boluarte-duro-de-25-a-30-minutos-asegura-el-canciller-pensabamos-que-iba-a-ser-10-minutos/ |work=infobae |date=20 May 2025 |language=es-ES }}</ref> and Ukrainian president [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Mpoke Bigg |first1=Matthew |title=Zelensky Meets With Pope Leo After Inaugural Mass |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2025/05/18/world/europe/zelensky-pope-mass-vance-rubio.html |access-date=20 May 2025 |work=The New York Times |date=18 May 2025 }}</ref>

On Monday, 19 May, Leo met with US Vice President [[JD Vance]] and Secretary of State [[Marco Rubio]]. Vance appeared to give Leo a [[Chicago Bears]] jersey with the name "Pope Leo" and number "XIV".<ref>{{cite news |last1=Hudson |first1=John |last2=Faiola |first2=Anthony |last3=Boorstein |first3=Michelle |title=Vance and Rubio meet with pope in push to reset relations with Vatican |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2025/05/19/pope-vance-rubio-trump/ |access-date=19 May 2025 |newspaper=The Washington Post |date=19 May 2025 }}</ref> Leo also met with [[Gustavo Petro]], president of Colombia;<ref>{{cite news |title=Pope Leo XIV meets with Colombian President Gustavo Petro |url=https://www.vaticannews.va/en/pope/news/2025-05/pope-leo-xiv-audience-colombia-president-gustavo-petro.html |access-date=19 May 2025 |work=www.vaticannews.va |date=19 May 2025 |language=en |archive-date=20 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250520004114/https://www.vaticannews.va/en/pope/news/2025-05/pope-leo-xiv-audience-colombia-president-gustavo-petro.html |url-status=live }}</ref> [[Bartholomew I of Constantinople|Bartholomew]], the [[ecumenical patriarch of Constantinople]];<ref>{{cite news |last1=Mindala |first1=John |title=Ecumenical Patriarch Bartholomew and Pope Leo XIV Meet in Rome, Plan Nicaea Meeting in November |url=https://archons.org/bartholomew-leo-meeting/ |access-date=19 May 2025 |work=Archons of the Ecumenical Patriarchate |date=19 May 2025 }}</ref> [[Gerardo Werthein]], Minister of Foreign Affairs and Worship of Argentina; and representatives of other churches, ecclesiastical communities, and religions.<ref>{{cite web |title=Audiences |url=https://press.vatican.va/content/salastampa/en/bollettino/pubblico/2025/05/19/250519c.html |publisher=Holy See Press Office |access-date=19 May 2025 |date=19 May 2025 |archive-date=19 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250519160324/https://press.vatican.va/content/salastampa/en/bollettino/pubblico/2025/05/19/250519c.html |url-status=live }}</ref>

In the days following the inauguration, Leo took possession of the other [[major basilica]]s, with ceremonies held at the [[Basilica of Saint Paul Outside the Walls]] on 20 May, and at the [[Archbasilica of Saint John Lateran]] and the Basilica of [[Santa Maria Maggiore]] on 25 May, formally installing him as the Bishop of Rome.<ref>{{Cite web |date=25 May 2025 |title=Pope Leo XIV declares 'I am Roman!' as he completes formalities to become bishop of Rome |url=https://apnews.com/article/rome-pope-bishop-ceremony-basilicas-ae01507115934e82a15e5f6758d08637 |access-date=27 May 2025 |website=AP News |language=en }}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Pronechen |first1=Joseph |title=John Paul II's Birthday, Leo XIV's Inauguration: A Papal Coincidence |url=https://www.ncregister.com/features/pope-leo-xiv-inauguration-john-paul-iis-birthday-papal-coincidence |access-date=19 May 2025 |work=National Catholic Register |date=16 May 2025 |language=en }}</ref>
